name: glb-label-editor
description: Two-stage cosmetic label design and GLB production, preview, validation, and export

interface.shortDescription: Design first, then produce cosmetic labels on GLBs
interface.longDescription: Use Cosmetic Label to design and approve the label system, then Cosmetic Label Editor to inspect packaging GLBs, apply front, back, and wrap labels, preview craft effects, validate print data, and export PNG/PBR assets plus labeled GLB files.
defaultPrompt: Design this cosmetic label with $cosmetic-label, then produce it on the GLB with $cosmetic-label-editor.
Turn this approved label design into an Editor Handoff and export a labeled GLB.
Open the label editor so I can review the result.
